observations.description: Local-in Virtual Patch fails to inspect traffic when using the HA-MGMT interface.

After upgrading FortiOS to the latest Frontier AI vul fix v7.2.14, 7.4.13, 7.6.8 and 8.0.2, the client browser shows net::ERR_EMPTY_RESPONSE only for the websites on non-standard HTTPS ports(eg., 8443 or 8011) with deep inspection enabled. Other standard HTTPS websites are working as expected.
FortiGate may fail to upgrade from FortiOS v8.0.1 build0245 via GUI.
observations.workaround: Upgrade using TFTP from the CLI.

observations.description: Eicar passes when two security policies are configured, first one denies application and second one enables AV scan.
observations.workaround: Use wildcard policies to block AV reliably

observations.description: Traffic disruption occurs when WCCP is enabled on FortiGate
observations.workaround: Direct all related traffic to master FPC

observations.description: UESP packet drop occurs when VPN peer uses different source ports for IKE-NATT and UESP
observations.workaround: Add a flow rule to work around the issue

observations.description: Traffic disruption occurs when kernel routes are not synchronized across the FPM.
observations.workaround: Run diag test application chlbd 3 on the slot that's missing routes to trigger a manual routes redownload.

observations.description: 6000F / 7000F support Multipath IPsec feature #1235059

HA status on the Global Dashboard changes unexpectedly during hard refresh
Fabric Connector status shows as DOWN in GUI after failover on Azure SDN Connector cluster
observations.workaround: Logout and login again to the GUI

observations.description: Traffic logs cannot be viewed when Resolve unknown applications is enabled
observations.workaround: Disable Resolve unknown applications under the global settings of log settings

observations.description: Unresponsive GUI occurs when httpd is fully loaded on the forward traffic page
observations.workaround: Disable Resolve unknown applications in the log settings

Display issues occur in FortiView widgets when FIPS-CC mode is enabled
observations.workaround: Create another super-admin profile to assign to the new admin.

observations.description: On FortiFirewall, GUI displays incorrect log traffic status when firewall policy is configured via CLI
observations.workaround: Use set logtraffic all/disable instead of unset logtraffic

Upgrading to 8.0.1 GA.F configuration with names beginning with a period "." will be lost
observations.workaround: Before upgrading, rename any configurations whose names begin with a period (.).
